strategy_notes: SELECTIVE MOMENTUM WITH EARNINGS AWARENESS — Portfolio is 4 positions, ~50% invested, ~50% cash. Key rules: (1) Universal bearish MACD = take profits at +13-15%, no exceptions. (2) Earnings binary risk: hold through only if position is <15% of portfolio and at/near breakeven — the asymmetry favors holding when downside is limited. Sell before earnings if sitting on large gains. (3) Sector diversification: max 2 names in identical sub-sector. NVDA/GOOGL/META are acceptable because they represent chips/search/ads despite all being 'tech'. (4) Non-confirmers get 4 trading days from entry — GOOGL and META both on the clock. (5) Trailing stops: for positions up 5%+, set mental stop at half the gain. For positions up 10%+, tighten to 60% of gain. (6) Post-earnings breakout buying is statistically superior to pre-earnings speculation — after META reports, look for post-earnings winners to add. (7) Cash buffer at 40%+ when MACD universally bearish. (8) JPM adds financial sector diversification — monitor relative strength vs tech.
